name: powos units (from the repo checkout)
purpose: HACK: the image (powos 0.3.0, 0f5e878, built from master) has no `powos units`; /usr/local/bin/powos routes `units` to the git checkout /var/home/powos/Projects/PowOS (branch worktree-powos-multiplatform, `git pull` updates it) and everything else to /usr/bin/powos. Real fix: an image with powos-units, rpm-ostree upgrade + reboot at a quiet time, then remove this
